visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male character wearing a black baseball cap and a pink oversized T-shirt sits at a wooden desk in a studio environment. He has a silver watch on his left wrist and a small lavalier microphone on his collar. He looks at a clipboard and smiles. A ring light is visible on the left side. (2) He uses a black marker to draw on the clipboard. He flips the board to show three simple sausage-like shapes with plus signs. His expression is playful and expectant. He is looking at someone off-camera. (3) The man displays a second drawing featuring a circle with dots and a shape with a bite taken out. He is laughing and pointing at the board. The lighting is bright and even studio light. (4) A transition occurs to an outdoor night scene. The man is seen from behind, wearing a black T-shirt with nine colorful food-themed illustrations. Neon signs of a night market are blurred in the background. (5) Close-up shots show the man eating a fried snack on a stick and a tomato. He wears a black watch in these scenes. Graphics appear showing '2025 Summer'. (6) Product showcase phase: Four different colored T-shirts (black, white, pink, beige) are displayed on red plastic stools. A young boy in a black shirt sits in a yellow play structure, and a young girl in a white shirt sits on a park swing. (7) Back to the indoor studio. The man claps his hands together, smiling at the camera. Graphics of the T-shirt lineup and a website link appear above him as he gestures.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-tempo electronic BGM with a strong beat starts immediately. A male voice speaks energetically in Mandarin. A sharp 'Ding' SFX sounds as titles appear. (2) Faint paper rustling occurs as the character draws. A 'Whoosh' and 'Impact' SFX trigger during the reveal of the drawing. Loud laughter and a surprised 'Wah cow' vocalization follow. (3) The BGM continues at 120 BPM with heavy synthesizer layers. A cartoon 'Pop' SFX sounds during a graphic reveal. The speaker's pitch rises in excitement. (4) Transition to a more professional but high-arousal narrative tone as the man describes product features. Upbeat electronic textures remain continuous. (5) Final phase features a 'Clap' sound and a rhythmic musical sting as the speaker delivers a call to action.
